title: "Hydrology and Ecosystems"
subtitle: "Three dataset options for your EAES 380 final project"
---

*MacroSheds is also listed under [Biogeochemistry](../biogeochemistry/macrosheds.qmd).*

### 1. [Hubbard Brook Streamflow](hubbard-brook-streamflow.qmd)

*Hubbard Brook Experimental Forest: Daily Streamflow by Watershed, 1956–present*

Continuous daily streamflow records from nine small watersheds (12–77 ha) at the Hubbard Brook Experimental Forest in New Hampshire.

EDI package: `knb-lter-hbr.2.15`

### 2. [Harvard Forest Hydrology](harvard-forest-hydro.qmd)

*Prospect Hill Hydrological Stations at Harvard Forest (since 2005)*

Long-term hydrologic measurements on two small watersheds in the Prospect Hill Tract of the Harvard Forest, Massachusetts.

EDI package: `knb-lter-hfr.70`

### 3. [MacroSheds](macrosheds.qmd)

*MacroSheds Watershed Synthesis (also listed under Biogeochemistry)*

MacroSheds provides harmonized daily discharge, chemistry, and watershed attributes for >200 small watersheds and is equally valuable for hydrology-focused projects.

EDI package: `edi.1262.2`
